import pandas as pd

# Define source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_36/test_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_36/test_1.csv"
]

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
df0 = pd.read_csv(source_files[0], index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source_files[1], index_col=0)

# Both source tables have exactly the same schema as the target table.
# According to Hint 2 and Hint 4, since schemas are identical, UNION (concat) is the preferred operation.

# Concatenate the two dataframes vertically (union)
df = pd.concat([df0, df1], ignore_index=True)

# Ensure data types match the target schema exactly:
# Target Schema:
# ['tripduration': int, 'starttime': str, 'stoptime': str,
#  'start station id': int, 'start station name': str,
#  'start station latitude': float, 'start station longitude': float,
#  'end station id': int, 'end station name': str,
#  'end station latitude': float, 'end station longitude': float,
#  'bikeid': int, 'usertype': str, 'birth year': int, 'gender': int]

# Convert columns to correct types, handling missing or malformed data gracefully

# tripduration: integer
df['tripduration'] = pd.to_numeric(df['tripduration'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

# starttime, stoptime: string (keep as string)
df['starttime'] = df['starttime'].astype(str)
df['stoptime'] = df['stoptime'].astype(str)

# start station id: integer
df['start station id'] = pd.to_numeric(df['start station id'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

# start station name: string
df['start station name'] = df['start station name'].astype(str)

# start station latitude: float
df['start station latitude'] = pd.to_numeric(df['start station latitude'], errors='coerce').fillna(0.0).astype(float)

# start station longitude: float
df['start station longitude'] = pd.to_numeric(df['start station longitude'], errors='coerce').fillna(0.0).astype(float)

# end station id: integer
df['end station id'] = pd.to_numeric(df['end station id'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

# end station name: string
df['end station name'] = df['end station name'].astype(str)

# end station latitude: float
df['end station latitude'] = pd.to_numeric(df['end station latitude'], errors='coerce').fillna(0.0).astype(float)

# end station longitude: float
df['end station longitude'] = pd.to_numeric(df['end station longitude'], errors='coerce').fillna(0.0).astype(float)

# bikeid: integer
df['bikeid'] = pd.to_numeric(df['bikeid'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

# usertype: string
df['usertype'] = df['usertype'].astype(str)

# birth year: integer
df['birth year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['birth year'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

# gender: integer
df['gender'] = pd.to_numeric(df['gender'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

# Reorder columns to match target schema exactly (just in case)
target_columns = [
    'tripduration', 'starttime', 'stoptime',
    'start station id', 'start station name', 'start station latitude', 'start station longitude',
    'end station id', 'end station name', 'end station latitude', 'end station longitude',
    'bikeid', 'usertype', 'birth year', 'gender'
]
df = df[target_columns]

# Write the result to the specified output path
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_36/target_multisource_cot.csv"
df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
